findings.evidence: grep of `TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/CliffordAlgebra/` shows `_last_positive` (BottPeriodicity.lean:1007) is the only lemma-name suffix in the directory using the full word `positive`; all eight other occurrences use `_pos`/`_neg`. Statements at 990-993 (`(Fin.castAdd (p + 1) (Fin.castSucc i)) = x (Fin.natAdd (p + 1) i)`, `i : Fin q`) and 1022-1025 (`(Fin.natAdd (q + 1) i) = x (Fin.castAdd q i)`, `i : Fin (p + 1)`) confirm the pos/neg swap, versus 842-845 where `_fst_pos` has positive on both sides.
findings.fix: Rename the trio uniformly and make the swap explicit, e.g. `realCliffordSignSwitchStandardIsometry_pos_apply_neg`, `_last_pos`, `_neg_apply_pos` (or, keeping it terse, `_pos_of_neg` / `_last_pos` / `_neg_of_pos`). At minimum, change `_last_positive` to `_last_pos` so the three siblings share one vocabulary.
findings.issue: The trio `realCliffordSignSwitchStandardIsometry_pos` (990), `_last_positive` (1007), `_neg` (1022) is inconsistently named twice over. (a) `_last_positive` spells out `positive` while its two siblings — and every other pos/neg suffix in `TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/CliffordAlgebra/` (`realBottIndexEquiv_symm_inl_pos/_neg` 447/452, `realBottSplitIsometry_fst_pos/_fst_neg` 538/548, `realCliffordPositiveSplitIsometry_fst_pos/_fst_neg` 842/855) — use the abbreviation `pos`/`neg`. (b) In `realBottSplitIsometry_fst_pos` and `realCliffordPositiveSplitIsometry_fst_pos` the `_pos` suffix marks a lemma whose source and target coordinates are both positive; here `_pos` marks the lemma whose RHS reads a *negative* source coordinate `x (Fin.natAdd (p + 1) i)`, `i : Fin q`, and `_neg` reads a *positive* one `x (Fin.castAdd q i)`. The same suffix thus means positive↦positive nearby and positive↦negative here, so the block swap that is the whole point of the isometry is invisible in the name.

summary: Names mostly follow the file's existing `realClifford*`/`realBott*` precedent and no notation is introduced, but the three coordinate lemmas for `realCliffordSignSwitchStandardIsometry` use mutually inconsistent suffixes, and `_pos`/`_neg` there carry the opposite meaning from the identically-suffixed sibling lemmas 150 lines above.
